verdict.rationale: The only concrete speed figure comes from an apparent Cerebras-side comment on Hacker News saying the draft model has been seen to 'break 300 tok/s' in coding workloads. The first-party docs offer only adjacent material: Prometheus latency metrics for dedicated endpoints and a qualitative claim that payload optimization improves TTFT, with no published numbers. Community posts praise the speed anecdotally but give no Cerebras figures. Missing for 10: published first-party tokens-per-second or TTFT figures per model, a formal benchmark methodology, load-testing guides, and independent benchmark corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims

citations.quote: if you use it in a coding agent you'll probably notice it run a lot faster (we've seen it break 300 tok/s)
